purpose: Coverage of the full PTS decomposition path vs diagnostic proxy, from verified tracking-reconstruction labels.

code_path.construction: PTS = stretch(2PM,2) (x) stretch(3PM,3) (x) FTM; 2PM=BetaBinom(2PA,2P%), 3PM=BetaBinom(3PA,3P%), FTM=BetaBinom(FTA,FT%), averaged over conditional-active minutes
code_path.conversion_grounding: 2P% and FT% fit ONLY from tracking-reconstruction labels; ungrounded players fall back to proxy (pts_construction='proxy')
code_path.unit_tests: tests/opportunity/test_pts_decomposition.py (7 tests: stretch, normalized/nonneg, mean==2*E[2PM]+3*E[3PM]+E[FTM], minutes-averaging, reconstruction identity on persisted labels, bundle full-vs-proxy, unavailable-without-labels)
code_path.full_12fold_oof_run: NOT RUN per owner instruction (no long OOF now); build + unit-test only

honest_note: Full decomposition is available only on tracking-covered seasons (2025-2026). Pre-2025 rows and the 1 SOURCE_MISSING tracking game (24896) have no reconstruction and remain on the proxy. This path is built and unit-tested; it has NOT yet been scored in a full OOF.
